choices.text: I'm here to talk, not fight. Let's find a way that works for everyone.
Leave now and no one gets hurt. That's the best deal you'll get.

onSuccess.text: The leader's eyes narrow, weighing your words against the risks.

onFailure.text: The leader scoffs. 'Big words from someone outnumbered.'

choices.text: I'll give you one chance. Run, or I'll make you regret it.

onSuccess.text: Something in your eyes convinces them you're serious. The leader hesitates.

onFailure.text: 'You've got guts, I'll give you that. Stupid guts.' Weapons are drawn.

onCriticalFailure.text: Your threat comes off as desperate bluster. They smell weakness.

choices.text: I can see you're in a difficult situation. Tell me what drove you to this.
[Assess their numbers and readiness]

onSuccess.text: You count {enemyCount} bandits. Some look nervous - this isn't a hardened warband.

onFailure.text: They notice you sizing them up. The leader glares at you.

assess_situation.speaker: bandit_leader
assess_situation.text: 'Talk, you say? What's there to talk about? {settlementName} won't listen to us.'

choices.text: What exactly do you want from {settlementName}?
Maybe I can help mediate. What would it take for you to move on?
Doesn't matter what they did. Extortion isn't the answer.
That's... actually reasonable. Let me see what I can do.
You're asking for too much. Be realistic.

onSuccess.text: The leader grudgingly nods. 'Fine. What do YOU think is fair?'

onFailure.text: 'Realistic? We're STARVING. Don't talk to me about realistic!'

choices.text: I can't help with that. You need to leave, one way or another.
I hear you. What you've been through isn't fair.
There are better ways to handle this. Let me help you find one.
I understand your pain. But this path will only bring more suffering.

onSuccess.text: The leader's eyes glisten. 'You... you actually care.' Their voice cracks.

onFailure.text: The leader looks away, jaw tight. 'Spare me the pity.'

onCriticalSuccess.text: The emotional breakthrough is immediate and profound.

choices.text: Everyone has a sad story. Doesn't justify robbery.

opening_up.speaker: bandit_leader
opening_up.text: 'You're the first person who's actually listened. Not just come to run us off.'

choices.text: I'll go back to {settlementName} and speak on your behalf. You have my word.

onSuccess.text: The leader nods slowly. 'Your word, huh? Alright. We'll give you three days.'

onFailure.text: 'Words are cheap. We've heard promises before.'

choices.text: I have some gold. Take it, buy supplies, and move on to better prospects.
Come with me to {settlementName}. I'll vouch for you - get you honest work.

onSuccess.text: The leader considers this. 'Honest work... been a while. You'd really vouch for us?'

onFailure.text: 'They'd spit on us. We're marked as bandits now. There's no going back.'

choices.text: Let me talk to {settlementName}. I'll get them to negotiate fairly.
Gold. Enough to get you somewhere you can start over.
I happen to know the town guard is mobilizing. You don't want to be here.

onSuccess.text: Their eyes widen. 'The guard? Damn. We're out of here.' They start packing camp.

onFailure.text: 'Liar. The guard hasn't left that town in months. You think we're fools?'

choices.text: I... don't have anything concrete to offer yet.

promise_help.speaker: bandit_leader
promise_help.text: 'Alright. We'll give you a chance. But if {settlementName} refuses to help, we're done talking.'

bribe_offer.speaker: bandit_leader
bribe_offer.text: The leader counts the gold carefully, then nods. 'This'll get us to the next region. You've bought our departure.'

choices.text: Half what you're asking. {settlementName} can't afford more.

onSuccess.text: 'Half... alright. Half. But they pay by week's end.'

onFailure.text: 'Half? We're not running a charity. Full amount or we stay put.'

choices.text: Not gold - supplies. Food, tools, blankets. Things you actually need.

onSuccess.text: The leader considers. 'Supplies we can use... yeah, that works.'

threat_response.speaker: bandit_leader
threat_response.text: 'You've got nerve. But nerve won't save you if this goes bad.'

choices.text: I'm not here to negotiate. Leave, or face the consequences.

onSuccess.text: Your unwavering confidence shakes them. 'Fine. This territory isn't worth dying over.'

onFailure.text: 'Big talk. Let's see you back it up!'

choices.text: You don't want this fight any more than I do. Let's find another way.
Look, I'd rather not fight. But I will if I have to. Can we talk first?

intimidated.speaker: bandit_leader
intimidated.text: The leader swallows hard. 'Alright, alright. We're leaving. Just... give us an hour to pack up.'

near_combat.speaker: bandit_leader
near_combat.text: 'Last chance, friend. Walk away, or we end this right here.'

choices.text: Fine. I'm leaving. But this isn't over.
No. YOU walk away. Now.
Wait! I have gold. Take it and go. Please.

escalation.speaker: bandit_leader
escalation.text: 'You're not making this easy. Last chance - what's it going to be?'

choices.text: I'm sorry. Let's start over. What do you need from {settlementName}?
I'm not backing down. Make your choice.
Here - take this gold. Just leave peacefully.

last_chance.speaker: bandit_leader
last_chance.text: 'This is getting us nowhere. One last time - give us a reason not to fight you.'

choices.text: Because bloodshed helps no one. Let me find a solution that works for everyone.

onSuccess.text: The leader sighs deeply. 'Fine. One day. Find us a solution or we're back to this.'

onFailure.text: 'Words. Always just words. We're done here.'

choices.text: I'll pay you. Name your price.
I've tried. If you won't listen, then so be it.
This is pointless. I'm leaving.

need_proof.speaker: bandit_leader
need_proof.text: 'Why should we trust you? What proof do we have you'll keep your word?'

choices.text: Here - take this. I'll return with an answer from {settlementName}, or you keep it.
I swear on my honor. If I fail, I'll come back and help you myself.

onSuccess.text: The leader studies your face, then nods. 'Your honor it is. Don't disappoint us.'

peaceful_desperate.speaker: bandit_leader
peaceful_desperate.text: 'Thank you. For listening. For trying. We'll wait to hear from you.'

peaceful_wronged.speaker: bandit_leader
peaceful_wronged.text: 'We'll give the settlement one more chance. But this is their last opportunity to make this right.'

peaceful_opportunists.speaker: bandit_leader
peaceful_opportunists.text: 'Business is business. We have an agreement. We'll keep our end if they keep theirs.'
